title: Blocked reason enforcement for unfinished dependencies
description: When the graph validator or picker detects that a task has unfinished dependencies, the blocked_reason should identify which dependency is blocking. Update the graph validator to emit warnings for tasks that are todo/in_progress but have unfinished depends_on items. Update the picker's skip warning to include the blocking dependency IDs. This is informational enforcement (warnings and skip reasons), not automatic status mutation.
stop_condition: Picker skip warnings include blocking dependency IDs. Graph validator reports tasks with unfinished dependencies. Tests verify both.
